paragraphs: Rav Yirmeyah bar Taḥlifa. R. Yaakov said to him, 'I shall explain it to you,' Avodah Zarah (42b), chapter Ḥezkat HaBattim (60b); and he spoke to him, Yoma, chapter Yom HaKippurim (78a). In Zevaḥim (63a): R. Akiva said to him; Rashak writes that it should read R. Yaakov. R. Yirmeyah bar Abba's student, end of chapter 1 of Ta'anit. I did not find this; rather, Rabbah bar Taḥlifa said: R. Yirmeyah bar Abba said (see his entry).
